description: This file defines the StreamWrapper class for handling Amazon S3 storage via PHP stream wrapper interface, enabling operations such as open, read, write, delete, and directory listing on S3 buckets using 's3://' URLs.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: Implements a PHP stream wrapper for Amazon S3, supporting file and directory operations over s3:// URLs, including open, read, write, delete, directory listing, and metadata functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the s3:// stream wrapper with a provided S3 client, optionally with caching and V2 existence checks.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream and flushes if necessary.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens the stream for reading or writing based on mode ('r', 'w', 'a', 'x').

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream data to S3, uploading if in write mode.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream body.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream body if seekable.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream body.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes an object from S3.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns metadata about the current object.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Provides information about a file or directory, utilizing cache when available.

methods.name: initProtocol
methods.description: Parses the protocol (e.g., 's3') from the given path.

methods.name: createStat
methods.description: Creates a stat array for a file or directory, based on head or list object responses.

methods.name: statDirectory
methods.description: Handles stat for directories, including buckets and 's3://' root.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new bucket or pseudo-folder on S3.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes an empty bucket or subfolder.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory (bucket or prefix), setting up a paginator for listing objects.

methods.name: dir_closedir
methods.description: Closes directory handle and cleans up.

methods.name: dir_rewinddir
methods.description: Resets directory reading to the beginning.

methods.name: dir_readdir
methods.description: Returns the next entry in a directory listing, updating cache.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats a key URL for cache storage.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames or moves an object within S3 via copy and delete.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Cast to other resource types (not supported).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates parameters for opening streams, including modes and existence.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves stream context options, optionally removing internal data.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stream context option.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Fetches the S3 client from the stream context.

methods.name: getBucketKey
methods.description: Extracts bucket and key from the URL.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Combines URL with options to produce a bucket/key array.

methods.name: openReadStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream body by executing a GetObject command.

methods.name: openWriteStream
methods.description: Prepares a temporary stream for writing.

methods.name: openAppendStream
methods.description: Attempts to append to an existing object, or falls back to create a new.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Handles error triggering based on flags.

methods.name: formatUrlStat
methods.description: Creates a stat array for a given object or directory listing.

methods.name: createBucket
methods.description: Creates a new S3 bucket.

methods.name: createSubfolder
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-folder on S3 by creating an empty object with a trailing slash.

methods.name: deleteSubfolder
methods.description: Deletes a subfolder if empty.

methods.name: determineAcl
methods.description: Returns an ACL string based on file mode.

methods.name: getStatTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for stat array.

methods.name: boolCall
methods.description: Executes a callback, catching exceptions to trigger errors.

methods.name: getCacheStorage
methods.description: Gets or initializes the cache storage object.

methods.name: clearCacheKey
methods.description: Removes a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns size of the current object body.
